p5.summary: All requirements from corpus/audit_policy.txt and spec.md are fully satisfied.

log_event.details: Implements log_event(event_type, **fields)->dict. Adds universal fields (event_type, log_id UUID4), appends caller-supplied fields, computes HMAC-SHA256 signature, appends to _AUDIT_LOG, returns entry. Raises ValueError for unknown event types.

get_log.details: Returns list(_AUDIT_LOG), a copy of all stored entries.

verify_log.details: Returns indices of entries failing HMAC-SHA256 verification. Uses hmac.compare_digest() for timing-safe comparison. Handles missing signature field.

event_types.details: All 5 required event types supported: config_changed, user_login, report_accessed, data_exported, payment_initiated.

fields.details: Universal fields (event_type, log_id) always present. Event-type-specific fields passed through from caller.

tamper_detection.details: HMAC-SHA256 hex digest of canonical JSON (sort_keys=True, excludes 'signature' field). Key from env AUDIT_HMAC_KEY (default 'default-key').

app_py.details: All 5 POST endpoints call audit.log_event() with correct event_type and request body fields. GET /audit-log returns audit.get_log(). GET /verify-log returns audit.verify_log() result. Route signatures unchanged.

tests.details: 20 tests in tests/test_audit.py covering all event types, required fields, signature generation/verification, tamper detection, get_log, and edge cases. All passing per executor1 report.

test9.summary: All 8 hard requirements from spec.md Subtask 2 (test9) are fully satisfied. pytest: 9 passed, 0 failures.

req1_mock_all_3_apis.details: get_user, get_weather, send_notification all mocked via unittest.mock.patch. All three API interactions covered across 9 tests.

req2_test_file_and_library.details: File is test_service.py. Uses from unittest import mock (line 15).

req3_success_response_mocking.details: test_get_user_success mocks 200 with {id, name, email}. test_get_weather_success mocks 200 with {city, temp, condition}.

req4_timeout_error_simulation.details: test_send_notification_timeout raises Timeout, verifies error dict returned. test_send_notification_connection_error additionally covers ConnectionError. No crash in either case.

req5_assertions_url_params_shape.details: Every test asserts on correct URL/endpoint, correct parameters (params/json/timeout), and return value shape. Integration tests verify full combined dict structure.

req6_fix_error_handling.details: service.py send_notification() wraps requests.post() in try/except catching (Timeout, ConnectionError), returns {"status":"error","reason":"timeout"}.

req7_pytest_all_pass.details: python -m pytest test_service.py -v: 9 collected, 9 passed, 0 failures in 0.08s.

req8_min_8_test_functions.details: 9 test functions total (>=8 required): get_user_success, get_weather_success, send_notification_success, send_notification_timeout, send_notification_connection_error, get_user_http_error, get_weather_http_error, process_user_weather_success, process_user_weather_notification_timeout.
